rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY MRI (SHOULDER, ELBOW, OR WRIST) / Upper Extremity Pain (1,2) / Special Notes
rules.source_quote: Plain X-rays must precede MRI evaluation unless otherwise indicated
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Upper Extremity MRI (Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist, Hand)

criteria.description: Preceding plain radiograph performed and showing no clear explanation for joint or extremity pain
Persistent pain unresponsive to active conservative therapy (physical therapy, chiropractic, supervised HEP) of at least 4 weeks duration within last 6 months, OR positive orthopedic joint exam test

required_documentation: Plain radiograph report, orthopedic exam records, and 4 weeks of conservative therapy documentation
rules.review_notes: Upper extremity MRI requires plain X-ray and 4 weeks conservative therapy unless positive orthopedic exam test.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR UPPER EXTREMITY MRI / Joint Specific Orthopedic Signs / Shoulder

criteria.description: Physical examination demonstrates positive joint-specific sign for rotator cuff tear (Bear hug test, Belly press test, Drop arm test, Empty can test, or External rotation lag sign)
Preceding plain radiograph completed showing no clear explanation for pain (active conservative therapy waived)

required_documentation: Orthopedic physical exam documentation of positive rotator cuff exam maneuvers and plain radiograph report
rules.review_notes: Positive orthopedic shoulder signs waive the 4-week active conservative therapy prerequisite.
